pkgmetadata.description: Scalable configuration management system based on convergence and Promise Theory
pkgmetadata.longdescription:
CFEngine is a configuration management system built around the principle of convergence, ensuring that systems automatically move toward and maintain a defined desired state through repeatable corrective actions.
Convergence combines the specification of a desired end-state with corrective operators that remain stable once equilibrium is reached, providing predictable and deterministic infrastructure behavior.
Its architecture is based on Promise Theory: components declare voluntary promises about their intended behavior rather than being centrally commanded. This decentralized model enables scalable coordination, fault tolerance, and emergent stability in distributed systems. Policies describe promises, and the CFEngine agent continuously evaluates and enforces them to maintain integrity and consistency.
Designed for autonomy, scalability, and minimal resource usage, CFEngine provides deterministic policy enforcement suitable for infrastructures ranging from single nodes to large distributed environments.
